Gurugram Bans Smoking in All Public Places, Imposes Fines

Gurugram's Municipal Corporation has declared all public places under its jurisdiction as no-smoking zones, with immediate effect. The directive also prohibits the littering of tobacco products. Offenders face fines of up to Rs 200, and compliance will be monitored.
